_comment: Full label extent (the label box: vast/launch.py --job label). The trainer sections inherit DEFAULTS; the A100 training recipe for long epochs (eval cadence, schedule, mix) is decided in the A100 plan before it is launched. extent: the label set (kitsune/extent.py); inputs {} takes every upstream input of every named source. All label roots and the selection lie under extent.root (labels/full, write-once on the Hub). label: the label box's settings (vast/label.py); workers 'auto' is computed from the box's effective cores. The trainer reads neither extent, parakeet_root nor label.
